units.meaning: Section heading for 14 CFR § 61.56 regarding flight reviews, containing no independent substantive requirement.

source_spans.quote: § 61.56   Flight review.

units.meaning: Except as provided in paragraphs (b) and (f) of § 61.56, a flight review consists of a minimum of 1 hour of flight training and 1 hour of ground training.
